description_en: Retrieves the WAN 4G NIC information of a Smart Access Gateway device
description_zh: 获取智能接入网关设备WAN 4G网卡信息
name: DescribeSagWan4G

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Smart Access Gateway instance
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Smart Access Gateway
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

parameters.help_en: The serial number of the associated Smart Access Gateway device
parameters.help_zh: 绑定的智能接入网关设备序列号
parameters.name: smart_ag_sn

Ip.description_en: The IP address of the 4G NIC

Mac.description_en: The MAC address of the 4G NIC

Priority.description_en: The priority of the 4G NIC. The default value is 99, which indicates the lowest priority. The priority cannot be modified
Priority.description_zh: 4G网卡优先级。优先级默认值为99，表示最低优先级，且优先级不支持调整

Status.description_en:
The status of the 4G NIC. Valid values:
Normal: The status is normal.
Abnormal: The status is abnormal.
Unavailable: No 4G NIC is available
Status.description_zh:
4G网卡状态：

Normal：状态正常。
Abnormal：状态异常。
Unavailable：无4G网卡

Strength.description_en:
The 4G signal strength. Valid values:
High: Strong.
Middle: Medium.
Low: Weak.
Unavailable: No signal
Strength.description_zh:
4G信号强度：

High：强。
Middle：中。
Low：弱。
Unavailable：无信号

TrafficState.description_en:
The traffic status of the 4G NIC. Valid values:
active: The 4G NIC acts as the active link, and current traffic is transmitted through this 4G NIC.
standby: The 4G NIC acts as the standby link and does not forward traffic. If the active link fails, traffic is transmitted through this 4G NIC
TrafficState.description_zh:
4G网卡流量状态。

active：表示该4G网卡为主用链路，当前流量经过该4G网卡进行传输。
standby：表示该4G网卡为备用链路，暂不转发流量。在主用链路故障后，流量经过该4G网卡进行传输
